data: In the leftmost graph, is the accuracy value of the red triangle higher than the accuracy value of the blue square at the point where the average number of questions is 1.5?

The question asks whether the accuracy value of the red triangle is higher than the accuracy value of the blue square at the point where the average number of questions is 1.5. 

From the figure, we can see that the red triangle represents Prob-Acc(qm), and the blue square represents Dropout-Acc(qm). At the point where the average number of questions is 1.5, the red triangle (Prob-Acc(qm)) is positioned above the blue square (Dropout-Acc(qm)). This indicates that the accuracy value of the red triangle is indeed higher than the accuracy value of the blue square at this point.
